speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Right Femoral Neck Fracture.

Thank you for the details. Given the mechanism of injury, immediate pain in both knees and severe right groin pain, combined with the likely abnormal leg positioning, I am highly concerned about a femoral neck fracture. Can you confirm if there is any visible shortening or external rotation of the right leg compared to the left, and is the right leg currently bearing any weight?
